changes: Replaced the prior blanket blocker with fit-specific coverage dispositions after checking the actual source columns, key uniqueness, outcome vintages, and measurement ends.
Kept the focal patent issue-year clock at 1996–2005 and requested endpoint 2010. Pooled the original period with supported added years in the same native reghdfe stage.

Retained the accepted treatment terms, controls, fixed effects, clustering, and transformation steps. For dynamic fits, retained the 2000 policy year and added event-year interactions only through each outcome's supported endpoint.
Ran the one controller-authorized Stata stage under the frozen bwrap author profile. Controller receipt confirms a successful stage, unchanged inputs/code hashes, and fresh aggregate output.
limitations: Available local vintages are the accepted construction's named versions: Kogan patent/citation source documented as Sep 2023; CD index file cdindex_cross_20190513; KPST_Breakthrough_v201912; annual_cleaned built from Compustat Aug 2022. These support different horizons; no more recent substitute was introduced.

The 3-year citation regression is capped at the last fully supported annual cohort, 2006. The accepted winsor/log transformation runs before the fit-specific cap; consequently later right-censored 3-year outcome rows in the loaded pooled file may affect its winsor cutoff. The native fit and e(sample) counts are real, but this is a transformation caveat for both static and dynamic 3-year comparisons.

For 5-, 7-, and 10-year citation outcomes, the named citing-patent issue-date source ends 2010-11-02. The latest fully followed annual cohorts are 2004, 2002, and 1999. Added-year cohorts beyond 2005 are not fitted for these outcomes; the original accepted window retains its inherited incomplete late-cohort follow-up.
The 10-year CD index is only observed through focal year 2008; 2009–2010 are omitted for that outcome. The five-year CD and KPST outcomes support the full requested endpoint.

The pooled model's original-period e(sample) N differs slightly from the predecessor standalone regression N (for example, 416,369 vs. 416,286 for all citations). Because the regressions are jointly estimated on a larger fixed-effect sample, singleton handling may differ; this explanation is an inference, not independently established by the logs.

The native Stata text log prints an internal close timestamp of 24 Nov 2024, while the controlled runtime receipt records the fresh run on 2026-11-18. Freshness and input/code integrity are established by the controller receipt and hashes.
The accepted code calls coefplot but contains no graph export; no figure files are claimed.
